'''Aimi Tomita''' is an artist who worked as a graphic designer and Pokémon designer for the [[Generation III]] core series games. She was also a concept artist for the character designs for the movies ''[[M07|Destiny Deoxys]]'', ''[[M06|Jirachi Wish Maker]]'' and ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]'', as well as the special ''[[The Mastermind of Mirage Pokémon]]''. Additionally, she made illustrations for the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. Aimi has illustrated {{PAGESINCATEGORY:Illus. by Aimi Tomita}} cards (excluding reprints). A full list of cards illustrated by Aimi can be found [[:Category:Illus. by Aimi Tomita|here]].
